versions.content: Support post-build hooking tools for rapid prototyping 27 of 47  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 86: AUTOSAR_RS_BSWModuleDescriptionTemplate Requirements on Basic Software Module Description Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Type: valid Description: The BSW module description template shall the support post-build hooking tools for rapid prototyping through the description of the implemented RP memory interface. The RP memory interface consists of unambiguous memory locations at which RP tools can modify the value subsequently used. Rationale: Post-build hooking tools needs to identify the correct memory location to insert the hook. Dependencies:  Use Case:  Supporting Material: 
